head: de8c05da70f9256bad361a930368d5c783c5571c
summary: Strict candidate scope binding is correct, but the published package_id fallback contract and missing operator-visible mismatch count must be corrected before release.
inspection: Reviewed the story, architecture, reconciler, workflow handoff contract, Mission Control UI, unit tests, and E2E coverage. The reviewer ran the reconciler unit suite (31/31) and focused E2E suite (7/7).
judgment_delta: The stricter binding was initially considered low-risk, then blocked after confirming the producer contract still advertised run_id or package_id and Mission Control collapsed out-of-scope calls into a generic no_candidate_call state.

findings.detail: candidates_write_back advertises run_id or package_id while the reconciler now requires an exact run_id match.
Mission Control does not render mismatched_candidate_calls, so an excluded call is indistinguishable from no call.
